name: re-entrant-loft
why: A re-entrant loft section, allowed since sections no longer need to be convex: a ruled loft between an L and the L at half size is the frustum h/3 (A1 + A2 + sqrt(A1 A2)) = 5250 mm3 exactly, every wall planar. A pairing that slipped one vertex would twist the walls into saddles and read short: the twisted-loft tripwire applied to a non-convex outline.
